body.name: Independent-saturation saddle feasibility system
body.construction: The system seeks \(p\in\Delta(\mathcal A)\), a clipped table \(\delta_{n\omega}\), \(\pi\in\Delta(\mathcal K)\), and \(v\in\mathbb R\) such that \(\sum_{n,\omega}d_n(p)H_{\kappa n\omega}(\delta_{n\omega}-\theta_\kappa)^2\le v\) for every \(\kappa\), and \(b_n(\pi)\ge v\) for every \(n\), where \(d_n(p)=\prod_q\binom{m_q}{(n_{q,a})_a}\prod_ap_a^{n_{q,a}}\) and \(0^0=1\).
inputs: the primal and dual orbit data
